description: A utility class for date formatting and manipulation, including timestamp generation, date formatting, and processing posted date parameters from HTTP requests.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation, as well as instance methods for processing posted date parameters.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string in the format yyyymmddhhmmss.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using the default date format.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string representing the year.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a long date string with day, date, month, year, time, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string with the default date format.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object using the default date format.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current date plus a specified number of days.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HttpServletRequest to set startDate and endDate fields.
